name: HoldForge
description: Turn Silicate macros into editor Options Triggers with dual input support and diagnostics.

strict-240.name: Strict 240 TPS
strict-240.description: Reject non-240 TPS macros. Turning this off converts time, but does not reproduce custom-TPS physics.

offset-ms.name: Timing offset (ms)
offset-ms.description: Positive = later. Use for in-game calibration. Applies to macro events, not the initial control block.

x-offset.name: Position offset
x-offset.description: World-unit offset for every generated trigger, including the initial block. Prefer time offset across speed changes.

backup-level.name: Backup before import
backup-level.description: Save the raw editor level string before inserting a batch. Import stops if backup cannot be written.

unsafe-timeline.name: Experimental timeline
unsafe-timeline.description: Allow dash, teleport, timewarp, Player Control and direction mechanics. Placement may be wrong. This is NOT a trajectory simulator; reversed or overlapping X remains rejected.

allow-existing-controls.name: Allow existing control triggers
allow-existing-controls.description: Existing Options Triggers may override the generated batch. Normally imports stop when control triggers already exist.

debug-enabled.name: Enable diagnostic journal
debug-enabled.description: Write a bounded latest.jsonl, flushing each event for crash diagnosis. Export logs creates a single JSON report.

debug-inputs.name: Log decoded macro inputs
debug-inputs.description: Frame, input type, player, press/release and TPS. Re-import the macro after enabling.

debug-mapping.name: Log time-to-position mapping
debug-mapping.description: Record each generated frame/time/X/P1/P2 and the editor timeline roundtrip.

debug-runtime.name: Trace playtest inputs and triggers
debug-runtime.description: Record button events, actual Options activations, editor damage, progress ticks and both player positions. Includes normal play as well as editor tests. Adds logging overhead.

debug-objects.name: Include generated object strings
debug-objects.description: Include serialization in mapping events. Requires Log time-to-position mapping.

debug-mods.name: Include mod versions
debug-mods.description: Record installed mod IDs, versions and loaded state for compatibility diagnosis. Captured when importing.

debug-max-events.name: Diagnostic event limit
debug-max-events.description: Report retains the newest N events. Crash journal writes the first N events of the session. Oldest ring entries are counted as dropped.
